P1 / High Priority Functional Bugs (5)

#2

Summary Data Does Not Refresh After Activity Logging

📍 Summary

After logging an activity, Summary widgets continue displaying stale values until the page is refreshed manually.

#3

"View All" Opens Activity Logging Instead of Activity Listing

📍 Diary → Activities

Clicking View All from the Activities card redirects users to the Log Activity flow instead of displaying the complete activity history.

#5

Guided Meditation Completion Is Not Reflected Anywhere

📍 Mindfulness → Guided Meditation

Completed Guided Meditation sessions are successfully finished but are not reflected in Summary, Diary, or Mindful Minutes.

#6

Logged Smoking Data Is Successfully Saved but Never Displayed

📍 Track Habits → Log Smoking

Smoking activity is successfully persisted through the backend, however the logged data is never reflected anywhere in the frontend.

#7

Diary Water Intake Displays Inconsistent Units

📍 Diary → Intake

The logged water intake is displayed using mixed measurement units. The consumed value is shown in ml/fl oz while the target value is displayed in Litres, creating inconsistent unit representation and reducing readability.

Suggestion: Users generally think of daily water intake in Litres, Glasses, or Fluid Ounces. Both consumed and target values should always be presented using the same unit for better readability.

UI / UX Bugs (4)

#8

Logged Activities Card Loses Log Entry CTA

📍 Diary → Activities

When no activities are logged, a "+" icon is shown indicating that users can manually log an activity. After logging the first activity, this visual affordance disappears completely, making the section appear non-interactive. The ability to add another activity should remain consistently visible regardless of whether activities already exist.

#9

Activity Detail Modal Has Inconsistent Typography & Spacing

📍 +Add → Track Habits → Any Habit

The activity detail modal has inconsistent visual hierarchy: insufficient spacing between Today and the activity title, insufficient spacing between the title and description, and font hierarchy that doesn't follow the visual hierarchy used elsewhere in the app, making content harder to scan.

#10

Goal Text Overlaps Divider in Log Water Screen

📍 Log Water

The Goal label overlaps the divider below it, resulting in an inconsistent layout.

#14

Update Weight Modal Contains Empty Space Before Input

📍 Log Diary → Update Weight

The Update Weight modal displays a large empty area before the weight selector, resulting in inefficient space utilization and unnecessary scrolling.

Accessibility (2)

Keyboard focus is not trapped inside Log Water modal

📍 Log Diary → Log Water

Opening the modal does not move keyboard focus into it; Tab moves through background page elements instead.

Keyboard focus is not trapped inside Log Smoking modal

📍 Track Habits → Log Smoking

Same issue as Log Water — focus stays on the page body on open and Tab moves to the background header instead.

#19

Grammar Issues in Global Banner & Snapshot Card

📍 Global email-verification banner + Summary Snapshot card

Miscellaneous (2)

#20

Quick Add Dropdown Remains Visible Behind Continue-in-App Modal

📍 +Add → Workout tab → Sync Steps History / Measure Heart Rate

Opening a Continue in App modal does not dismiss the Quick Add dropdown. Both layers remain visible simultaneously, resulting in overlapping UI states.

#21

Close (X) Does Not Dismiss Underlying Dropdown

📍 +Add → "Continue in app" modal

Since the dropdown remains open behind the modal (Issue #20), clicking Close (X) only dismisses the modal while leaving the dropdown visible.

⚠ Dependent on Issue #20.
